## Context

Why this exists. What's broken, missing, or worth improving.

## What "done" looks like

Verifiable statements an agent or human can check against the PR.
Prose, bullets, or checklist — any format fine. Each item should be
answerable: did this happen or not?

## Notes / Open questions

Non-blocking context, design debates, unknowns.
